name: feishu-traework-local-auth
description: Optional helper to reuse this machine's user-owned TraeWork Feishu authorization with official lark-cli environment credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse your own TraeWork Feishu auth on this machine with official lark-cli.
interface.longDescription: Optional plugin for a person who already completed Feishu authorization for TraeWork on this computer. It reads only that OS user's Trae session, obtains a short-lived Feishu user token already granted to TraeWork, and injects it into one official lark-cli child process through LARKSUITE_CLI_* environment credentials. Each recipient must authorize on their own machine. Not the default Feishu Next auth path. Windows GBK + PowerShell has been live-tested.
defaultPrompt: Use $feishu-traework-local-auth:feishu-traework-local-auth to reuse this machine's TraeWork Feishu auth.
Use $feishu-traework-local-auth:feishu-traework-local-auth to verify the effective Feishu user identity.
Use $feishu-traework-local-auth:feishu-traework-local-auth to run the requested lark-cli command with that identity.
